caseName: Pierce Ford Sales, Inc. v. Ford Motor Co.
caseNameFull: Pierce Ford Sales, Inc. v. Ford Motor Co.
attorneys: John S. Burgess for petitioners., Whitney North Seymour, Osmer C. Fitts and Richard Hawkins for respondent.
judges: Amendment, Because, Certiorari, Guarantee, Inc, Jury, Right, Sales, Trial, Violation

opinions.text:
C. A. 2d Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black would grant certiorari in this case because he believes that petitioner Pierce Ford Sales, Inc., was denied its right to a trial by jury in violation of the guarantee of the Seventh Amendment.
